item.lumen_rigs.lighting_remote.help1: Use on a fixture: link / unlink it
item.lumen_rigs.lighting_remote.help2: Use on a block: aim the linked fixtures there
item.lumen_rigs.lighting_remote.help3: Use on a mob or player: follow it
item.lumen_rigs.lighting_remote.help4: Use in the air: shine where you look; sneak to forget all links
item.lumen_rigs.lighting_remote.too_many: A remote controls at most %s fixtures
item.lumen_rigs.lighting_remote.none_lin: No linked fixtures in range: use the remote on a fixture to link it
lumen_rigs.screen.mode.manual.hint: Points where the pan and tilt sliders say.
lumen_rigs.screen.mode.point.hint: Stays on the spot picked with the lighting remote.
lumen_rigs.screen.mode.follow.hint: Tracks the mob or player picked with the lighting remote, or the nearest player.
lumen_rigs.screen.mode.sweep.hint: Swings left and right around the pan and tilt.
lumen_rigs.screen.aim_at_me.hint: Points the fixture at your face.
lumen_rigs.screen.pan.hint: Turn left and right. Dragging it takes the aim back from the remote.
lumen_rigs.screen.copy.hint: Remembers all settings of this fixture to paste them onto other fixtures.
lumen_rigs.screen.paste.hint: Applies all copied settings: pan, tilt, beam angle, color, brightness, power, softness, range, beam visibility, redstone and sweep. Values this kind of fixture does not support are brought into its range.
lumen_rigs.configuration.title: Lumen Rigs
lumen_rigs.configuration.remoteRange.too: How far the lighting remote reaches: linked fixtures and aimed blocks, in blocks.
lumen_rigs.configuration.followRange.too: Fixtures stop following an entity that is further away than this, in blocks.
lumen_rigs.configuration.lighting.toolti: Let fixtures light up blocks and mobs. The light is client-side: it does not stop mobs from spawning.
lumen_rigs.configuration.colorStrength.t: How strongly colored light tints what it hits.
lumen_rigs.configuration.maxLights.toolt: At most this many fixtures (the nearest ones) light up the world at once. Moving lights re-render the chunks they reach, so lower this on weak computers.
On Minecraft 1.20.1 both values use the built-in block light: the Veil integration (AUTO) is only available for Minecraft 1.21.1.
lumen_rigs.screen.beam.hint: How wide the cone of light is.
lumen_rigs.screen.brightness.hint: The dimmer. Redstone in dimmer mode scales it further.
lumen_rigs.screen.power.hint: Strength of the lamp: brighter light that carries further.
lumen_rigs.screen.softness.hint: 0% is a crisp, hard-edged spot; 100% is soft, diffuse light that fades out over the whole cone.
lumen_rigs.screen.range.hint: How far the light reaches. A searchlight reaches 256 blocks into the sky.
lumen_rigs.screen.haze.hint: How much the beam shows in the air. Rain, storms and water make beams denser.
